title: Smithsonian concert, festivals, Mayor Bradley's key to the city and 'Roots'
summary: Brief answers about his Smithsonian concert, Newport and Monterey, a key to the city after fifty-two years and a song in 'Roots'.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: How about your concert? Tell me about your concert at the Smithsonian.
Well...ain't much to talk about that. We were... a bunch of us out on this show together. That's about all.
Who else was on the show with you...?
Oh, don't ask me.
Okay.
I don't remember.
And you played both the Newport and the Monterey Jazz Festivals. Right?
Right.
I've seen you several times at Monterey, I know. And, tell me about being honored by Mayor Bradley. When was that?
That was coupla years ago...when I had my fifty... second year in show business. He honor...give me a key to the city.
Reel 5
Oh, that's nice.
Mmmmmm hmmmmmm.
I'm sure he's a fan of yours 'cause I know Tom Bradley...
Yeah, I been knowin' him for years
I know he's a fan of good music. Uh...
Yeah.
And, in...what did you do in "Roots"? I mean, you sang in "Roots," but what part of "Roots" were you in?
Huh?
"Roots."
Well, I done a song in "Roots" when the people's comin' outa the meadow part, I was singin' "In The Evenin' When The Sun Go Down."
Mmmnn hmmmmmm. Were you...were you on camera?
No, I'se...just my voice.
